spec.name: Full Send Roulette Table
spec.description: A three-block-square walnut roulette table base, centered on the original block and spanning X/Z -16..32. Height remains 12 units. Emerald felt and brass perimeter finish exactly at Y=12, forming a clear, flat top. Four sturdy legs reach Y=0. No wheel, chips, markings or accessories.

prompt: Create a Minecraft normalized 0..16 block model for a Full Send roulette table base to stretch 3 blocks wide and 3 deep, height unchanged. Dark polished walnut square table, brass corners, deep emerald felt exactly at Y=12, 4 sturdy legs reaching Y=0. Keep the ENTIRE top surface clear and flat: wheel/ball/number labels and betting pads are added separately. No wheel, no chips, no text or symbols. Beautiful detailed pixel texture, vanilla cuboid geometry. High contrast golden edge trim.
